an4.244:1.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ
an4.244:1.7: gacchatha bho imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṃghāṭakena siṃghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindathāti
an4.244:1.8: tamenaṃ rañño purisā daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṃghāṭakena siṃghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindeyyuṃ
an4.244:1.10: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ sīsacchejjaṃ
an4.244:1.11: yatra hi nāma rañño purisā daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathiyā rathiyaṃ siṃghāṭakena siṃghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindissanti
an4.244:1.12: so vatassāyaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpakammaṃ na kareyya sīsacchejjanti
an4.244:1.13: evameva kho bhikkhave yassakassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā evaṃ tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pārājikesu dhammesu
an4.244:1.14: tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ anāpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati āpanno vā pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati.
an4.244:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā musalaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya
an4.244:2.2: ahaṃ bhante pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti
an4.244:2.4: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ
an4.244:2.5: yatra hi nāma kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā musalaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhati
an4.244:2.6: ahaṃ bhante pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ mosallaṃ yena me āyasmanto attamanā honti taṃ karomīti
an4.244:2.7: so vatassāyaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpakammaṃ na kareyya gārayhaṃ mosallanti
an4.244:2.8: evameva kho bhikkhave yassakassaci bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā evaṃ tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti saṃghādisesesu dhammesu tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ anāpanno vā saṃghādisesaṃ dhammaṃ na āpajjissati āpanno vā saṃghādisesaṃ dhammaṃ yathādhammaṃ paṭikarissati.
an4.244:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā assapuṭaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya

an4.244:3.5: pāpakaṃ vata bho ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ assapuṭaṃ
an4.244:3.6: yatra hi nāma kāḷakaṃ vatthaṃ paridhāya kese pakiritvā assapuṭaṃ khandhe āropetvā mahājanakāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhati
an4.244:3.7: ahaṃ bhante pāpakammaṃ akāsiṃ gārayhaṃ assapuṭaṃ
